title: Raider Rehab Warmup Program
author: J B.
desc:
This program can be used both as Rehab, and a preventative warmup protocol to help reduce injuries by strengthening tendons and muscles that are often neglected.

Originally designed as a companion to the Raider 2025 program, it can be used in conjunction with any program independently.

ex.note: Elbow and scapula stable, tension at 90 deg, slow eccentric, progress band as tolerated.

2 sets each arm.
Scapula stable and lower as comfortable, slow eccentric 3s
Shoulders back and down, lifting arms up, add incremental weights when tolerated
Put a heavy weight up at a comfortable angle, push against pad
Slow eccentric, up with 2, down with one, as heavy as tolerated
To progress do Static Single Leg variations or Single Leg RDL dynamic variation.
